_README: Single source of truth for money. Every dollar shown on the site comes from here. Edit numbers, commit, done - no code changes. The build FAILS LOUDLY if allocations do not sum to the pool, so you can never publish a broken table.
derivation: 21-team/$5,250 structure rescaled to 17 teams/$4,250. Weekly held at $100/wk x 14. Toilet Bowl held at one full buy-in ($250). Remaining $2,600 split between regular-season and playoff buckets on the original 53.97/46.03 ratio, then rounded to clean dollars.

playoffs.label: Championship Playoffs (Weeks 15-18, top 7 reset to zero)

toiletBowl.label: Toilet Bowl (Weeks 15-18, bottom 10 reset to zero)
